name: Idol Death Game TV
source:
Idol Death Game TV is broken down into exploration, judging, and 'Death Concert' elements. During exploration players will look for useful items throughout each stage, as well as exchange information with other 'Project 47' idols. Player interactions may have the effect of altering your confidence or 'spirit,' or doing the same to the other idols. Giving yourself an edge in these interactions will be important for the 'Death Concerts.'

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/idol-death-game-tv/13/70aa75?li_medium=default-widget&li_source=LI&ref=liftigniter]Play-Asia[/url]]

The story focuses on the "Dream of Dream" or D.o.D. competition, which sees potential idols in a contest to take the center position in the Project 47 idol group. However, the 10th D.o.D. competition takes place at Shichibōkan, a mansion nestled deep in the mountains, and will involve the idols fighting for their lives, with the lowest in the popularity rankings executed in a "death game" broadcast on live television. 

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2016-08-16/idol-death-game-tv-ps-vita-game-promo-reveals-characters/.105426]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
《偶像死亡游戏TV》分为探索、评判和“死亡音乐会”元素。在探索过程中，玩家将在每个阶段寻找有用的物品，并与其他“Project 47”偶像交换信息。玩家互动可能会改变你的信心或“精神”，或者对其他偶像也有同样的效果。在这些互动中让自己占据优势对于“死亡音乐会”来说非常重要。

[来自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/idol-death-game-tv/13/70aa75?li_medium=default-widget&li_source=LI&ref=liftigniter]Play-Asia[/url]]

故事围绕“Dream of Dream”（D.o.D.）展开。竞争，潜在的偶像在Project 47偶像团体中争夺中心位置。然而，第10国防部长比赛在深山七芳馆举行，偶像们将为了生存而战，人气排名最低的选手将在电视直播中进行一场“死亡游戏”。

[来自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2016-08-16/idol-death-game-tv-ps-vita-game-promo-reveals-characters/.105426]动漫新闻网[/url]]
